_comment: scripts/platform_ctl.py: what 'stop' and 'start' touch. project = this demo's workloads only; platform = the shared CDP services of the environment as well (also used by sibling demos). No NiFi, Kafka, Flink or streaming jobs in this project; Data Visualization is the CAI application 'Mule Data Visualization', not a CDW instance. CDE stops before CAI: the DAG's cai_sync_code / cai_daily_score tasks start the CAI jobs; CDW starts first: the app, the endpoint and the scoring job read Impala. Names are resolved at run time.
